title: 区切り線いろいろ
subject_en: Horizontal decorative divider lines, each ONE wide thin strip about 5:1 in shape, centred in its cell with space around, made of repeating small cute motifs (flowers, stars, ribbons, hearts, clouds) along a line. The strip must be separate and not touch other strips. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text.
lead: おたよりやブログの見出し下に使える、横長の区切り線12点です。花・星・リボンなどの装飾をそろえています。
items: a horizontal divider of small pink and yellow flowers connected by a green vine
a horizontal divider of yellow stars of varying sizes on a thin line
a horizontal divider made of a tied red ribbon with flowing ends
a horizontal divider of small hearts of alternating pink and red
a horizontal divider of small blue-grey clouds with tiny raindrops
a horizontal divider of green leaves along a branch
a horizontal divider of coloured dots of various sizes
a horizontal divider shaped like blue sea waves with small shells
a horizontal bunting garland of small triangular flags in pastel colours
a horizontal divider of small brown paw prints walking along
a horizontal divider of pale-blue snowflakes of varying sizes
a horizontal zigzag divider in orange and teal with small dots
